videos.title: Beautiful White Moonflower in Full Bloom 🌸 #shorts
videos.description:
Take a close-up look at this stunning, crisp white moonflower in full bloom. With its large, delicate trumpet-shaped petals, this striking plant is a true garden standout. Known for unfurling as the sun goes down, these night-blooming beauties add a glowing, magical touch and a sweet fragrance to any evening garden.
